copyHelp: If X does not open, copy the text and URL to create your post.

copyManual: Select the text and copy it manually.

rankingSendFailed: Could not submit your score. Your result remains on screen.
rankingLoadFailed: Could not load rankings. Your result remains on screen.
nameDisclosure: If you enter a name, your name and score will be public in the rankings. You can play with this blank.
guestResult: You played without a name. This score will not be public.

intro: Pour colors between bottles until every bottle is sorted.
rule1: Tap a source bottle, then a destination to move the matching layers at the top.
rule2: The destination must be empty or have the same color on top.
rule3: Each bottle holds up to 4 layers.
rule4: To finish, every bottle must be empty or full with 4 layers of one color.
rule5: Retiring does not submit a ranking score.
sourceEmpty: An empty bottle cannot be the source.
differentColor: The top colors do not match.
poured: Poured. Tap the next source bottle.
noMoves: No moves are available. Undo one move or retire.
noUndo: There is no move to undo.
confirmRetire: Retire? No ranking score will be submitted.
confirmHome: Return home? This run will end without submitting a ranking score.
statsUnknown: Could not load the play count.
rankingInfo: A shorter clear time ranks higher.
notSubmitted: You retired. No ranking score will be submitted.
countUnknown: The play count could not be confirmed.
shareDescription: Sort the colors in the bottles in this puzzle game.
